summary: Built a bounded interaction reference and verified the package contracts.

system_view.intent: Give Mozare a project-centered surface for reviewing agent work.
system_view.behavior: The interface opens on project state and keeps technical detail behind progressive disclosure.

decisions.decision: Keep canonical state local and vendor-neutral.
decisions.rationale: Recovery must not depend on a cloud interface.

technical_terms.plain_system_meaning: The durable records that remain authoritative even if the interface is rebuilt.
technical_terms.why_it_matters: It prevents an AI app or visual view from becoming the only copy of project reality.
